ext_description.message: Capture posts into BRUV cards and slide decks

toast_clipped_no_pin.message: Clipped, but couldn't pin — the card is in the Inbox. Check the pin target in Options (the category may not accept this card type, or belongs to another vault).

toast_queued.message: Server unreachable — clip queued, will retry

toast_failed.message: Clip failed — see the extension console

toast_not_paired.message: BRUV Clipper isn't paired yet — open its options

toast_no_deck.message: No deck target set — pick one in the BRUV Clipper popup

toast_no_plugin.message: Nothing clippable on this site yet

toast_no_unit.message: Couldn't find a post here — right-click directly on one

popup_not_paired.message: Not paired with a BRUV server.

popup_no_deck.message: No deck selected — clips become cards only

popup_card_has_no_deck.message: That card has no slide deck block

popup_pending_error_no_tab.message: Couldn't open a tab for that clip

popup_pending_error_no_clip.message: Couldn't read the post on that page

options_bootstrap.message: Bootstrap token (from the server's bootstrap-token.txt / QR page)

options_paired_ok.message: Paired — now pick a repo below

options_pair_local.message: Pair automatically (this machine — no token needed)

options_err_unreachable.message: Can't reach the BRUV server at {url}. For a local pairing, make sure the desktop app (or the BRUV service) is running — the local server stops with the app, and its port can change if the fixed port was taken at startup.

options_category_stale.message: The saved pin target doesn't exist in this repo — clips will land in the Inbox until you pick a new one.

options_category_deck.message: Same location(s) as the deck target
